department: Faculty of Geoscience and Geography (Geoscience, GAUSS)

deadline.value: Winter-term applications close on 31 July, which is 31 July 2027 for the winter term that starts in autumn 2027. The 31 January deadline is for the summer term.
deadline.quote: 31st of July for the following winter term

gre_subject.value: The geoscience page does not mention a subject GRE.

supervisor.value: Before applying you must find two professors to supervise the project and discuss it with them.
supervisor.quote: Search for two professors as supervisors and discuss your doctoral project with them

funding.value: University-wide, the research group or department usually funds doctoral students by contract or scholarship; this is not a guarantee for every applicant.
funding.quote: Usually, the research group or department provides funding to their doctoral students in the form of either an employment contract or a scholarship

english_waiver.value: You must show English proficiency through an internationally recognised test or equivalent performance; the Application regulation sets the details.
english_waiver.quote: proof of sufficient (English) language skills by means of an internationally recognised test or equivalent performance

entry_route.value: The geoscience page does not say whether a Master's is required; the application regulation (Zugangsordnung) is not on the page.

notes: Entry route not stated on the page. The 2027-07-31 deadline is the winter-term round for entry in autumn 2027. Funding quote is the university-wide statement.
